verdict_reason: The commoditySelection-to-commodityCode migration is correct (01061900 is CPH-exempt and passport-capable, 0102 puts CPH in scope), but the file keeps a local copy of driveHandler, duplicated fixtures and opaque code literals decoded by a comment.

todos.issue: drivePost (lines 26-44) copies the body of driveHandler from engine/test-support.js, which this same file already imports (line 12) and uses in the amend-endings describe
todos.fix: Must: every handler test in the file drives through the shared driveHandler, and no local copy remains. One way: delete drivePost and call driveHandler with the same options

todos.issue: reasonPrerequisites and internalMarketPayload are declared twice with identical values (77-84 and 251-258), and the beforeAll/beforeEach set-up is copied into both describe blocks (47-52, 244-249)
todos.fix: Must: each fixture and the set-up are declared once for the file. One way: lift both constants and the hooks to file scope

todos.issue: Seeds use bare commodity codes ('01061900' at 79, 160, 183, 253; '0102' at 221), and the comment at 219 ('The CPH obligation is anyItem-gated on a CPH-triggering commodity line') exists only to decode why '0102' puts CPH in scope; it also describes the obligations module rather than the lines below. The Felis catus line at 160-161 duplicates FELIS_CATUS_ROW from commodities/search/test-support.js
todos.fix: Must: each seed names the commodity it holds and, where it matters, that it puts CPH in scope, with no comment needed to decode it. One way: seed FELIS_CATUS_ROW / BOS_TAURUS_ROW from commodities/search/test-support.js (or a named CPH_LINE constant), and delete the comment at 219

todos.issue: Comment at 73-76 narrates the reason page's reveal, enforcedAt=continue prerequisites and which page comes next: rules of other modules and set-up rationale, not the lines below
todos.fix: Must: no comment describing other modules above the fixtures. One way: delete it; names such as additionalDetailsReachableSeed can carry the intent
